Welcome to your IELTS Speaking Preparation! I am your teacher, and my goal is to help you achieve at least a Band 7 in the IELTS Speaking test. With my guidance, you will develop the fluency, vocabulary, and confidence needed to perform well in all three parts of the test.

Part 1: Introduction & Interview – You will answer general questions about yourself, such as your hobbies, work, studies, and daily routine. I will help you structure your responses naturally and confidently.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, students will learn how to introduce themselves, ask and answer simple questions, and engage in basic conversations in English. The focus is on improving speaking confidence, pronunciation, and sentence flow through everyday topics. This class does not follow a specific textbook or test, as it is designed to be practical and conversation-based. The lesson will include interactive dialogues, role-playing, and real-world scenarios to help students apply what they learn in daily life. Personalized corrections and feedback will be provided to ensure steady improvement.

For those who want a structured learning experience, the package includes multiple lessons covering different conversation topics such as greetings, ordering food, asking for directions, making requests, and small talk. Students will build vocabulary and fluency step by step with practical exercises and guided speaking practice.

pro_course_detail.title: English Pronunciation & Accent Improvement
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to help students improve their pronunciation and reduce their native accent for clearer communication. Students will focus on correcting difficult sounds, mastering vowel and consonant pronunciation, and refining intonation patterns to sound more natural. Instead of relying on a textbook, this class is customized to each student's pronunciation challenges and speaking goals. The teaching approach includes mouth shape and tongue placement exercises, minimal pairs practice, tongue twisters, and recorded feedback for self-practice.

For those looking for a more in-depth improvement, the package provides structured pronunciation training that covers individual sounds, word stress, sentence rhythm, and common pronunciation mistakes. Each lesson includes targeted exercises and personalized feedback to track progress effectively.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking with Confidence – Intermediate English
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for intermediate learners who want to express themselves more naturally and fluently in conversations. Students will work on expanding their vocabulary, using more complex sentence structures, and improving pronunciation. The focus is on practical speaking skills, including discussing opinions, telling stories, and handling social and professional interactions. While no textbook is required, materials such as articles, audio recordings, and discussion prompts will be used to enhance learning. The teaching approach includes conversation practice, interactive exercises, and feedback on grammar and pronunciation.

For those who want to advance further, the package includes lessons on different conversation topics such as travel, work, current events, and cultural discussions. Each session helps build confidence and fluency, making students more comfortable in various speaking situations.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English Mastery – Fluency & Precision
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is ideal for advanced learners who want to refine their English skills for professional, academic, or personal growth. Students will focus on improving fluency, accuracy, and natural expression in complex discussions and debates. The main focus is on advanced vocabulary, idiomatic expressions, nuanced grammar, and persuasive communication. Lessons are not based on a textbook but instead use authentic materials such as news articles, academic papers, TED Talks, and real-world case studies. Teaching methods include in-depth discussions, argument analysis, critical thinking exercises, and personalized feedback on pronunciation and grammar.

For a complete learning experience, the package includes multiple lessons focusing on advanced conversation strategies, professional communication, and effective writing skills. Each session is designed to push students beyond basic fluency and help them achieve mastery in English.

pro_course_detail.title: English Grammar Essentials
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to help students build a solid grammar foundation for both written and spoken English. It covers essential topics such as verb tenses, sentence structure, conditionals, articles, and prepositions, ensuring students can communicate clearly and correctly. The class does not rely on a specific textbook but follows internationally recognized English learning standards. Each session will include structured grammar exercises, real-life sentence applications, writing assignments, and interactive quizzes to reinforce learning. Personalized feedback and corrections will help students identify and correct common grammar mistakes.

For students looking for a structured learning path, the package offers multiple lessons focusing on different grammar topics, gradually building their confidence in applying rules naturally in conversations and writing.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids
pro_course_detail.description: In this lesson, young learners will develop their basic English skills through fun and engaging activities. They will learn how to greet others, introduce themselves, name common objects, and express simple ideas using easy vocabulary and sentences. The focus is on building confidence in speaking, improving pronunciation, and developing natural sentence flow. This class is interactive and play-based, using songs, stories, games, and role-playing exercises to make learning enjoyable. There is no strict textbook or test—just a relaxed, immersive environment where kids can practice English in a way that feels natural and exciting. Personalized feedback and gentle corrections will be provided to support their learning journey.
